Frequently Asked Questions
Does TradeHQ recommend buying Natural Gas?

No. TradeHQ is an educational simulator and does not rate assets as good or bad investments. Use the page to understand NG price drivers and to test a process with virtual funds.

How can a beginner practise trading NG?

Start by learning what tends to move NG, then use virtual funds to practise order types, position sizing, predefined exits, and post-trade review. Treat any risk percentage as a simulation setting rather than a universal rule.

What affects NG price?

NG price is influenced by supply/demand dynamics, geopolitical factors, currency movements, and seasonal patterns.
